notes.title: Controller Support & News!
notes.content:
[p]That's Right, Baby! 

CONTROLLER SUPPORT!

This was a challenge to get setup but honestly I'm glad I did it! If there is enough interest, I am planning on updating the controller support all the way to support different controller and devices. 

Anyway, that leads me to the updates. So I am still hard at work and pushing to get the demo out. My list of things to do before I release the demo is shrinking but daunting. As for what I did add to the game? I have been working hard getting the main features in the game functional and fun! I think I am at a good spot to start adding in more content for what's going to be in the demo!
[b]
Things I have added since our last update!
[/b]- Story Elements[/p][p]- Characters[/p][p]- Furniture[/p][p]- MORE FOOD[/p][p]- Farming

Anyway that's all for today, hopefully next time you hear from me I will be announcing the demo! 

Talk Soon XoXo
-Seth [/p]

notes.title: NEW FEATURES!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, I added new features to the game! 

[h1][u][b]New Features Added:[/b][/u][/h1]

[h2][b]Decorating[/b][/h2]
- Furniture Placing
- Furniture Selling

Complete control over the look of your kitchen with complete customization and tons of new furniture to come!

[h2][b]Day and Night Cycle[/b][/h2]
- Time Clock

I added a day night cycle to push the player through out the day during gameplay and give you all plenty of reasons to buy cool lighting for the boat! :D

[h2][b]Updated Fishing Mini Game[/b][/h2]

I updated the fishing mini game since the announcement to add more player input to the whole fishing process! More to come....

[h1][u][b]OVERALL THOUGHTS[/b][/u][/h1]

I am still adding a ton more features to the game and am planning to get a demo out ASAP! I am working on the game as much as possible and am adding to it everyday!

Signing off,
Seth
